calculation_handling.description: Where main walls of the same residential building face each other (a right-angle projection from one meets another), they must be at least 5.5 m apart above ground if one or more of them has no openings to dwelling units.
calculation_handling.gaps: Depends on building form (facing walls) and window/door placement, which are design inputs.

units.disclosure: Separation between facing walls of the same building depends on the building's shape and openings, which we do not evaluate.

evidence.dwelling_unit: an opening to a dwelling unit

calculation_handling.description: Facing main walls of the same building must be at least 11.0 m apart if each has an opening to a dwelling unit.
calculation_handling.gaps: Depends on building form and openings.

units.disclosure: Separation between facing walls of the same building depends on the building's shape and openings, which we do not evaluate.

calculation_handling.description: Where two or more residential buildings are on one lot, their main walls must be at least 5.5 m apart above ground if the front or rear main wall of one or more has no openings to dwelling units.
calculation_handling.gaps: Applies only with multiple residential buildings on a lot; depends on openings.

units.disclosure: Separation between multiple buildings on one lot depends on their layout and openings, which we do not evaluate.

evidence.dwelling_unit: an opening to a dwelling unit

calculation_handling.description: Multiple residential buildings on one lot: 11.0 m between main walls if each front or rear main wall has an opening to a dwelling unit.
calculation_handling.gaps: Applies only with multiple residential buildings on a lot; depends on openings.

units.disclosure: Separation between multiple buildings on one lot depends on their layout and openings, which we do not evaluate.

calculation_handling.description: Multiple residential buildings on one lot: at least 2.4 m between side main walls.
calculation_handling.gaps: Applies only with multiple residential buildings on a lot.

units.disclosure: Separation between multiple buildings on one lot depends on their layout, which we do not evaluate.

10.60.40.80(1).explanation: In the RT zone, where walls of the same building face each other, they must be at least 5.5 m apart. If both walls have windows or doors into homes, they must be at least 11.0 m apart.

10.60.40.80(2).explanation: Where there are two or more residential buildings on one lot, front or rear walls must be at least 5.5 m apart. If both walls have openings into homes, they must be at least 11.0 m apart. Side walls must be at least 2.4 m apart.
